result:
`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (6 tests, 0 failures); `bunx guren check` reports 9 passed with only the pre-existing "no test file for LoginController/ProfileController/DashboardController" warnings.

The bug was a single off-by-one in `PostController.index` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:14`): the validated 1-based `page` query param was being incremented before being handed to `Post…paginate({ page: page + 1, perPage: 10 })`, so page 1 rendered the second slice of results and the newest 10 posts were unreachable on every page — and, because `paginate()` from `@guren/core` derives its meta and links from the result's `currentPage`, the pager's highlighted page, first/last/prev/next URLs and from–to counts all described the wrong page too. Passing `page` through unchanged fixes the slice and every derived number at once; ordering (`id desc`), per-page size, and search are untouched. I also made the pager in `resources/js/pages/posts/Index.tsx` actually use the `active` flag it already receives (emerald border plus `aria-current="page"`), which is what the report describes as the highlighted page. New coverage lives in `tests/PostListPagination.test.ts`: it seeds 25 posts and asserts page 1 starts at the newest post with meta `1 of 3, 1–10 of 25`, that `?page=1` matches the query-less request, that pages 1–3 together yield all 25 posts exactly once in newest-first order, and that page 3 is the 5-item tail — I verified these three of the four fail against the pre-fix code.
